lesson.menu_desc: He works, she checks, it beeps -- what a robot does every single day
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 3 -- Robot Factory
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Dante | Lesson 3 -- Robot Factory

listenings.text: This is the night shift report. Bolt starts work at ten o'clock every night. First he checks the machines on the first floor. Then he carries the heavy boxes to the truck. He never stops and he never sleeps. At six in the morning he goes to the charging room. Nina arrives at seven. She checks Bolt's battery and she writes the report. She says Bolt is the best worker in the factory.

We have a small problem this morning. Bolt lifts the boxes with his left arm, but today the left arm does not move. It makes a strange noise, like a bird. So Bolt uses his right arm and he works very slowly. He carries one box every two minutes. Normally he carries one box every ten seconds. Please do not fix him now. The engineer arrives at four o'clock.
